name: Hunter’s Obliteration (Combat)
body:
Finishing a wounded victim requires an up close and personal touch.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Hunter’s Spring, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 7 ranks

Benefits: While using the Rising Hunter Style feat, after moving as a swift action using Hunter’s Spring you may choose to have your first successful unarmed strike deal double damage and allow you to hook onto the target. If the target moves, you move with them without provoking an attack of opportunity as though it were forced movement. If you take a move action while hooked onto a target, you may choose to spend any amount of movement in 5 foot increments instead of. The target’s next movement has an amount of movement equal to the movement you spent negated. The target may attempt to shake you off as a swift or standard action by making a CMB check against your CMD. If they do so, their movement is not negated. If you choose to move away, you are no longer hooked onto the target and their movement is not negated.

Special: This feat’s benefits apply to light weapons and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
